name: IGNITE
description: A destination-agnostic tourist safety and route-planning system for India. Uses a deterministic, multi-factor risk engine across six terrain profiles to fuse live weather, elevation, hazard mapping, and emergency-service proximity into explainable safety scores with real-time re-routing, SOS dispatch for low-connectivity areas.

paragraphs: Deterministic, mathematically explainable risk intelligence, spatial geofencing, and dynamic topological re-routing across all 28 States and 8 Union Territories of India.

IGNITE is a destination-agnostic tourist safety and dynamic itinerary engine engineered for the Indian subcontinent. Traditional travel platforms operate as static catalog directories or black-box recommendation models that remain oblivious to active cloudbursts, high-altitude acute mountain sickness (AMS), flash floods, and crowd stampede dynamics. IGNITE replaces opaque machine learning heuristics with deterministic, multi-factor mathematical risk engines paired with live geospatial telemetry (India Meteorological Department alerts, Open-Meteo atmospheric forecasts, real ground elevation…
